design.purpose: Make one six-pointed paper snowflake window decoration from one supplied 21 × 21 cm square of white paper, using the photographed scissors.

steps.c: Place the square sheet flat, plain side up.
Fold top-right corner onto bottom-left corner.
Fold top-left corner onto bottom-right corner.
Fold top-right edge through top at 30°.
Fold top-left edge through top at 30°.
Cut across the wide end of the wedge.
Cut a triangular notch from the left edge.
Cut a triangular notch from the right edge.
Cut a small notch across the pointed tip.
Open the sheet out flat again.
